cards.definition_principle: Predeclared level, trade-through, completed reclaim, and room to target.
measurable_predicates: The claim is compiled into versioned numerical predicates.
required_evidence: canonical completed candles or authoritative option snapshot
source and predicate version
valid_conditions: All cited inputs are complete, current, and time-safe.
failure_conditions: Required deterministic evidence is missing or stale.
contradictions: The principle does not establish a CITADEL probability.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as standalone direction, probability, risk, or execution authorization.
cards.paraphrase: Predeclared level, trade-through, completed reclaim, and room to target.

research_fields.regime_filter: Versioned context policy; skip directionless/tight overlapping range.
research_fields.setup_logic: Predeclared level, trade-through, completed reclaim, and room to target.
research_fields.invalidation_logic: Close back beyond the sweep extreme or protected structure.
research_fields.target_logic: Next verified liquidity/structure level; no fixed RR target.
research_fields.option_filter: Fresh exact contract, bid/ask/spread, Greeks and expiry where available.
research_fields.missing_data: Fail unavailable; do not proxy or infer the missing authority.
research_fields.cost_model: Executable bid/ask, fees and slippage must be included.
research_fields.backtest_plan: Compile predicates, freeze versions, replay authoritative records, include costs and failures.
research_fields.oos_plan: Immutable time split, trial accounting, untouched OOS evaluation and degradation checks.
research_fields.failure_analysis: Report no-trigger, invalidation, spread, stale data, regime transfer and target-room failures.
